title: Console rapid journal + triage checklist — Kai
content:
Morning rapid notes (today)
---
Quick context: logged in at 08:45 PT. Priority queue sticky: a customer (CS-2091) reported intermittent 502s from the console when opening the model config page. Might be related to the recent metrics endpoint change (INF-4821).

Immediate checklist (first 30 min)
- [ ] Look at live alerts: PagerDuty -> any active incidents? none at 08:50
- [ ] Grafana: open 'console/main-latency' + 'console/500-rate-by-route' (time range: last 2h)
- [ ] Kibana: filter by request.path: "/api/v1/console/models/*" and status: 5xx, then sort desc by timestamp
- [ ] Check rollout notes for GH-842 (metrics tweak) in case of incompatibility with older proxies

Quick commands I ran
- curl -s "https://obs-api-internal.redwood/v1/metrics?route=console" | jq '.routes["/models/config"].p50'  # returns 112ms (we expect ~60ms)
- kubectl logs -n console svc/console-backend -c http --since=2h | rg "500" | head -n 20

Initial observations
- Spikes in p95 and a handful of 502/503s concentrated around 07:52-08:10 PT (customer timezone report matches)
- Error path seems to be hitting cache layer: redis timeouts show up in the same window (connect ETIMEDOUT)
- GH-842 changed aggregation of route labels; possible label mismatch meant some latency buckets skipped, which could lead to misrouted fallback and surge to a less-scaled pool

Repro steps (attempted)
1) Load model config page for a large org (org_id=acme-enterprise) -> sometimes returns 502, reproduces at ~1/6 tries locally when proxying with --slow 200ms
2) Hitting API directly bypassing edge proxy -> consistently 200 (suggests edge/proxy or cache layer)
3) Simulated high concurrency (ab -n 200 -c 20) -> increases error rate from 0% to ~8% on my dev env when cache responses are cold

Short-term mitigation ideas
- Revert GH-842 aggregation change on canary if we can patch quickly (talk to Ella)
- Add temporary retry with jitter in edge proxy for 502 class errors (low risk)
- Increase Redis connection pool for console-backend for the next 4h as a stopgap (requires infra approval)

Follow-ups / tasks (my personal TODO)
- [ ] Ping Ella to sync on GH-842 rollback possibility (slot 10:30 PT)
- [ ] File a rollback playbook snippet in INF-4821 with steps + smoke tests
- [ ] Add a short note to CS-2091: "We're investigating 502s related to cache/proxy; temporary mitigations in flight" (assign to Omar for customer comms)
- [ ] Post reproducible test case to the obs-triage slack channel with low-noise label and example curl
- [ ] Add an alert for redis.connect.errors > 5/m to reduce time-to-detection

Notes to self / hypothesis bank
- Hypothesis A: label aggregation change made some routes fall into a default bucket that lacks autoscaling policies -> sudden surge overload
- Hypothesis B: redis network glitch in us-west-2 for ~20m (check infra network graphs)
- Hypothesis C: client-side resource (browser) hitting an unexpected large payload that triggers stream fallback (less likely given direct-api success)

Questions to resolve (for post-mortem)
- Who approved GH-842 and was it tested against the edge proxy variants?
- Did we ship any infra changes in the same deploy window? check infra deploy logs 07:30-08:30
- Is the autoscaler misconfigured for route label "console/models/config" after aggregation?

Signals to collect for deeper dive
- Full request traces for 07:40-08:15 for any 5xx -> link to traces: (todo: collect spans from trace service)
- Redis slowlogs around the window + connection open count per pod
- Edge proxy metrics: upstream latency + retry counts per upstream cluster

Quick drafts for customer message (short)
- "Thanks — we're seeing transient 502s affecting the console model config page for some customers. We're investigating cache/proxy interactions and will update within 60 minutes. Working on temporary mitigations now."

End-of-day/next steps (if unresolved)
- Prepare rollback PR draft and run smoke test against staging with edge-proxy variant A/B
- Schedule 30m post-mortem with Ella, Omar, and platform infra (include logs and timeline)
- Draft follow-up to CS with root cause and long term fix ETA

Random quick notes (scratch)
- Remember to check: infra/deployments/2026-03-11/edge-proxy-rc.log for potential warnings
- Save the error stack snippet: "CacheClient.connect: connect ETIMEDOUT at net.js:..." to INF-4821 as an artifact
- If I get a minute, run the synthetic test for large orgs in /scripts/bench_console.sh with --org acme-enterprise

-- K.N.
